bagPolicy.summary: Amerant Bank Arena discourages guests from bringing bags to events. If necessary, only small bags, clutches, crossbodies, and wristlets smaller than 4in x 6in x 1.5in are allowed.
prohibited: audio/video recording devices other than cell phones
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking is available at various gates with options for general, club, garage, and VIP parking. Pre-purchasing parking for events can save time and money. Pedestrians should use Gate 6 for access.

rideshare.note: Drivers enter through Gate 3 and exit through Gate 2. Drop-off is at the North Pedestrian Walkway entrance. After the event, pickup is at the northern end of that walkway.

concessions.note: Amerant Bank Arena offers a diverse menu of premier concessions available during Florida Panthers hockey games, concerts, and events. Highlights include the Funky Buddha Brewery Tap Room, Jameson Crossbar, and Patrón Patio, providing a range of drink options and social spaces.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Amerant Bank Arena, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not allowed except for emergencies. Speak to an Event Supervisor or Guest Services near the North Box Office before leaving.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Ticket information/Will Call is located on the Plaza Level at the South Box Office. The SeatGeek Box Office is open Monday-Friday from 9am to 5pm, with extended hours on event days.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Escalators are located at the main entrance of the building and lead to all levels of the arena.
